verdict.rationale: Pipedrive documents an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant find deals and get insights. It also has a documented REST API with Deals, Persons and Organizations endpoints, so an agent can pull open-deal data for an account brief. The evidence does not show that recent emails or activity history are reachable through the MCP server or API. missing for 10: documented access to email and activity history via API/MCP, evidence of compiling a combined account brief, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent compile an account brief — open deals, recent emails, and history — from CRM data via the API or MCP server before a meeting

citations.quote: Find deals, update records, get insights, move opportunities through your pipeline and automate workflows, all from your AI assistant.
This API uses a JSON format for output and is capable of handling CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) requests.
